headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: AIDSO stages protest in support of ASHA workers in Dharwad.
Israel commits 6,464 ceasefire violations in Gaza in 413 days.
Inside Story Of Sharad Pawar's 'Nexus' With Dawood Ibrahim.
Flex boards backing Shafi Parambil surface in Oommen Chandy’s home turf Puthuppally.
NDA-backed candidates will win over 90% of panchayat seats in second and third phase.
bullets_ur: AIDSO ne Dharwad mein ASHA workers ki himayat mein ehtijaj kiya.
